organization.discoveryNotes: Construction template: project sites, HSE, procurement, equipment yard, and CyberCrow baselines for contractor access.

workflows.name: RFI / change request
workflows.description: Site engineer submits change; PM and commercial review before approval.

workflows.name: Site HSE inspection
workflows.description: Scheduled inspections, findings, and corrective actions logged for audit.

workflows.name: Purchase order approval
workflows.description: Procurement raises PO; finance and PM approve per contract limits.

workflows.name: Equipment mobilization
workflows.description: Plant allocation to site with handover checklist and return tracking.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for PM, procurement, and finance approvers
Contractor and vendor access time-bound to project
Audit trail on PO and site incident records
NCA ECC alignment for identity and privileged access

integrations.notes: Corporate SSO for HQ and site leadership
Optional ERP for projects, procurement, and finance
Optional PMIS for drawings and RFIs

experienceRequirements.requirement: Portfolio dashboard: active projects, HSE open items, spend vs budget
Site control view with crews, inspections, and approval queue
Mobile-first site tasks, inspections, and PO status
CyberCrow console for contractor access and incident review

identity.ssoNotes: Construction template: Entra ID for HQ; MFA for approvers and site managers with financial authority.

security.complianceNotes: Separate contractor identities from employee roles; log site safety and procurement events.
